phase: P0-W: the game headless on Windows (x86_64)

findings: swift-build (Swift 6.4's default build system) reports 'unable to find platform for windows'; SwiftPM's native build system (--build-system native) builds

SwiftPM passes -resource-dir <sdk>/usr/lib/swift; the Windows SDK has no usr/lib/swift/clang, so Clang lost its builtin headers and fell through to MSVC 14.29's iso646.h, which includes yvals_core.h, a C++-only module: 'module std._Private.yvals_core requires feature cplusplus' while building SwiftShims. A link usr/lib/swift/clang -> the toolchain's clang/21 fixes it (shown by compiling an empty file with and without -resource-dir)

the prebuilt Foundation.swiftmodule references pow in the corecrt module ('reference to declaration pow broken by a context change', compiler crash); UCRT 10.0.26624 has pow in math.h, so the patch now maps math.h to corecrt.math (and removes it from ucrt.C.math) instead of dropping corecrt.math
the toolset gives Swift -visualc-tools-root/-windows-sdk-*, C/C++ clang -Xmicrosoft-* options, and lld-link the SDK library folders
